mitigation: Authenticate every caller and service (OIDC for users; mTLS or signed workload identity for services)
Sign or integrity-check messages and stored records; restrict write access to the owning service
Write tamper-evident audit logs of who did what with request ids
Encrypt in transit (TLS 1.2+) and at rest; least-privilege read access
Rate-limit and set quotas and timeouts; autoscale with a ceiling
Run with least privilege; authorise every action server-side on the end user's identity
Validate input schemas at every trust boundary
Back up data stores and test restore
Keep system instructions separate from untrusted content; mark and delimit retrieved and tool text as data
Screen inputs and retrieved content for injection patterns before they reach the model
Require human approval for high-impact actions proposed by the model
Red-team prompt injection (direct and indirect) before each release
Minimise personal data in prompts and context; mask or tokenise before the model call
Filter outputs for personal and secret data before they leave the system
Inventory models and components (AI-BOM / SBOM); pin versions; use vetted sources
Verify provenance and integrity (hashes or signatures) of models and datasets
Validate and approve data before it enters fine-tuning or the index; keep ingestion lineage
Treat model output as untrusted: validate against a schema and encode for its sink (HTML; SQL; shell)
Use parameterised calls for any query or command built from model output
Give tools the narrowest scope and no open-ended functions; separate read and write tools
Execute tool calls under the end user's permissions; never a shared admin credential
Set per-action limits (amount; count; rate) enforced outside the model
Keep secrets and authorisation logic out of prompts; enforce them in code
Test that the system prompt cannot be extracted (canary checks)
Enforce access control on retrieval by tenant and user permission; partition indexes
Ground answers in cited sources and show citations to users
Evaluate factuality on a regression set and route low-confidence answers to a human
Cap tokens per request and per user; set budget alerts and hard limits
Detect and throttle extraction-like query patterns
